Fact: integration_means
What to find: Technical means for integrating the model (usage instructions, APIs, serving frameworks, prompt/chat format).
Card sections that often contain it: How to Use, Quickstart, Usage, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Can be served with vLLM (custom granite_thinking_parser reasoning parser, qwen3_coder tool-call parser) and SGLang (v0.5.18+); accessed via OpenAI-compatible API or Hugging Face Transformers (apply_chat_template with enable_thinking, low_effort options); usable with agentic coding harnesses (OpenCode, Pi, OpenHands).
quotes: Granite-4.2-8B is optimized for deployment with [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm).
Granite-4.2-8B can also be served with [SGLang](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang) (v0.5.18+) for high-throughput inference.
Since it supports reasoning and tool calling via the OpenAI-compatible API, it integrates with popular agentic harnesses out of the box.
